response.text: The query budget is exhausted, so I'll submit what I have. The GLJRNL, GLPERD, APVEND and GLCOA queries were not run, and the SYSDICT documentation and sampled data are what I have to go on.

arguments.notes:
SCOPE / LIMITS: Query budget ran out after 9 successful/failed queries. NOT inspected with data: GLJRNL rows, GLPERD, APVEND, GLCOA (only column lists known). Relationships and codes below are from the SYSDICT dictionary and from sampled APINVH, APPAYM, GLJRNH rows only; anything marked UNVERIFIED should be checked.

ENGINE / NAMING: PostgreSQL-style database (sqlite_master not present; information_schema works). Table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted in SQL (e.g. "APINVH"."INV_ID"); unquoted lowercase names fail.

TABLES (public schema, all columns listed in information_schema):
- APINVH (AP invoice header): INV_ID int PK-like, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int (YYYYMMDD), INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (AP payments): PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int (YYYYMMDD), PAY_AMT numeric.
- APVEND (vendor master): VEND_CD char, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char. (Not sampled.)
- GLCOA (chart of accounts): ACCT_CD char, ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char. (Not sampled.)
- GLJRNH (journal header): JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int (YYYYMMDD), POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (journal lines): JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric. (Not sampled.)
- GLPERD (periods): PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int, STAT_CD char. (Not sampled.)
- SYSDICT (data dictionary): TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR text. Covers all tables above except it was not verified against the data.

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred, no declared FKs seen in the catalog):
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (padded char(8) on both sides; compare with trimming).
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID.
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (journal that recorded the invoice). Sample: invoice 1 -> journal 1000, source AP, SRC_REF = invoice number.
- Payments appear to be journalled too: GLJRNH rows with SRC_CD 'AP', SRC_REF 'PAY-n', memo 'Payment <invoice no>'. Sample shows payment 1 (invoice 2) journal 1002 and payment 2 (invoice 3) journal 1004 — payments do not map 1:1 to APPAYM.PAY_ID in journal numbering; verify.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (header/line); GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID; date-to-period mapping should be checked against STRT_DT/END_DT.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO: appears to be a reversal/reference link to another journal; sampled values were NULL (the string 'NULL' in output, so may be a true NULL) — UNVERIFIED.

CODES AND CONVENTIONS (per SYSDICT):
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD in all tables (INV_DT, PAY_DT, POST_DT, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT). Not DATE types.
- Amounts are numeric; invoices and payments are positive in sample. Journal lines carry separate DR_AMT and CR_AMT columns (sign convention is by column, not signed amount) — not verified in GLJRNL data.
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O open, P paid, V void.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: P posted, U unposted.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (payables), GL (general ledger). Sample showed only AP.
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF: per SYSDICT is the user who keyed the entry, BUT sampled values hold invoice numbers/payment refs (e.g. 'V0014-80297-1', 'PAY-1') — this contradicts the dictionary; treat SRC_REF as a source document reference, not a user.
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: O open, C closed. ACCT_TYP: ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE. ACTV_FLG / ACTV_FLG: Y active, N retired. VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are space-padded to 8 characters.

SUSPICIOUS / DOCUMENTATION ISSUES:
1. SYSDICT.SRC_REF description ("user who keyed the entry") disagrees with observed data (document references).
2. Sample invoice status: invoices 1 and 6 and 7 are 'O' open with POST_FLG 'P' posted; some invoices are 'P' paid with no visible linkage check performed — status consistency vs APPAYM not verified.
3. Invoice 1 (V0014-80297-1, 18731.53) is open with no payment seen in the 8 sampled payments; payments reference invoices 2,3,4,5,8,9,13,14 only in sample.
4. Journal dates: GLJRNH.POST_DT for invoice 4 (20240906) and invoice 5 journal are not in strict date order vs JRNL_NO and PRD_ID (e.g. JRNL 1003 posted 20240907 with PRD_ID 9 while JRNL 1001 with 20240202 has PRD_ID 2; JRNL 1005 POST_DT 20240906 PRD_ID 9 but JRNL 1007 POST_DT 20240202 PRD_ID 2) — PRD_ID/POST_DT alignment should be checked against GLPERD; possible period misassignment.
5. Payments in sample were posted to PRD_ID 2 or 9 with dates in other periods; verify period assignment rules.
6. Data dictionary coverage is complete at column level for the tables listed, but its accuracy is only partly verified (one definite contradiction found).

RECOMMENDED NEXT CHECKS (not performed): sample GLJRNL to confirm DR/CR sign convention and that each journal balances; confirm GLPERD date ranges and whether POST_DT falls within the assigned PRD_ID; check APVEND/GLCOA for inactive codes used in postings; test APINVH.STAT_CD against APPAYM totals (sum PAY_AMT vs INV_AMT); check for orphan INV_ID in APPAYM and orphan VEND_CD in APINVH.
